learning_outcomes.text: Apply elementary methods in photovoltaics in a targeted manner and confidently use the associated basic concepts of photovoltaics.
Analyze, design, and evaluate the different photovoltaic systems for off-grid and grid-connected systems.
Plan photovoltaic systems, e.g., with simulation software, and compare the results with measurement results, for example, from PV systems on the roof of Bielefeld University of Applied Sciences.
Critically review their measurement results and measurement strategy and interpret deviations from calculations and simulations.
Classify the results within the current state of research and development.

syllabus_topics: Structure and functioning of solar cells
Manufacturing processes of solar cells and solar modules
Simulation and measurement of photovoltaic systems

assessment_methods.method: Pre-test at the beginning of the lab practical
Post-test with discussion of measurement procedure and results at the end of the lab practical

assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination with examination prerequisites. The examination takes the form of a written exam, combined examination, or oral examination, each with an examination prerequisite. The examination prerequisites include an pre-test at the beginning of the lab practical and a post-test with discussion of measurement procedure and results at the end of the lab practical.
